fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, the photos show a new pontoon on a dealer showroom floor (Bennington design center signage, other new stock around it, warning tags still on the helm), so this looks like dealer stock rather than a private owner's boat.
findings: Pontoon logs on both sides look bright and unoxidized
Tan vinyl seating at the bow and lounge looks clean and unstained
Gray seagrass flooring throughout the deck looks clean
Helm console and dash look new, with factory stickers still in place
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crest Classic DLX 220. The pontoon logs and tan seating already look showroom clean in the photos. If you ever want a mobile detail or log polish down the road, we come to you. Would you like us to keep your info for a future quote?
